name: Fresnedoso de Ibor (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a blue wavy bend sinister from the lower hoist to the upper fly.
history: The arms and the flag of Fresnedoso de Ibor were approved by the Order of 16 April 1992 of the Consejería de Presidencia y Trabajo published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 28 April 1992, after the municipal council's approval on 28 February 1991.

features.role: wavy band from the lower hoist to the upper fly
